newsitem.title: USA: Freeze possible in U.S. Midwest September 24.
newsitem.headline: Freeze possible in U.S. Midwest September 24.

text.p: A cold front could bring freezing temperature from Kansas City to Chicago by September 24, said Fred Gesser, chief forecaster with Weather Express.
"Based on today's MRF (medium range forecast), I'm forecasting a 60 to 70 percent probability of there being a freeze north of I-80 (Interstate 80), 80 percent chance for Minnesota," Gesser said.

Gesser said the American forecasting models indicated a cold front would move into the western corn belt on September 21, bringing very cold temperatures. He put the freeze line from Kansas City to Chicago by September 24.
"The American model evolved into a very, very cold looking, freeze-like scenario for the 23rd to 24th time frame," he said. But he cautioned "the charts could change tomorrow."
